provisional: 2026-09 observed contracts; recent months may be revised

definitions.primary: p25_26 (exclusive square-pyeong rounded half-up to25 or26), epoch-invariant eligible sales including observed direct/cancelled labels; land leasehold excluded
definitions.strict: Eligible sales excluding observed cancellation and direct-sale labels; historical empty labels are not confirmed normal
definitions.price: Contract-weighted type7 quartiles; half-open0.1eok intervals, not confidence intervals; minimum40contracts and10complexes
definitions.age: Contract year minus current canonical construction year; unknown or future year separate
definitions.largest_removed: Remove one largest contract-count complex per setting; canonical identity breaks ties; rerun support
definitions.age5plus: Keep known contract age5years or older; not a causal adjustment
definitions.trade_age: 0–4years / known5plus / unknown contract shares in10percentage-point intervals; each positive contributing group at least10contracts
definitions.current_stock: Current surviving inventory, all and area-sum-source subset;0–9/10–29/30plus/unknown shares by complexes and known households; positive contributors at least10complexes
definitions.share_endpoints: 10pp half-open intervals except upper100 included;100 is stored in90–100, not an exact point
definitions.index: Current common-stock Carli model index,2026-01=100, rounded to1decimal; not observed medians or historical inventory
definitions.extrema: All possible and strictly separated maximum years from public intervals, with missing years retained; not exact maximum dates
definitions.widening: Consecutive-year change of absolute median gap, outward interval subtraction; ratio change separate
definitions.gaps: Mapo minus Seodaemun, Mapo minus Eunpyeong, Seodaemun minus Eunpyeong; outward signed/absolute/ratio bounds from displayed medians only

limitations: Current canonical geography and surviving-stock history; not a historical stock census.
Contract age0–4 does not identify actual first move-in year. Provider schedules are not complete actual occupancy events.
Differences reflect selected contracts, age, location, floors and other unadjusted composition; not causal effects, district rankings or forecasts.
Finite named-field review is not a universal nonlinear reconstruction or external-information guarantee.
